notes: Modified cash basis school district (basis=cash). Governmental funds Total Governmental Funds column (Exhibit III, p5 receipts and first disbursement lines, p7 remaining disbursements and balances). Bond proceeds 14,950,000 placed in debt_proceeds (printed inside Total Receipts, so reported_totals receipts includes debt_proceeds). Transfers in/out 144,666.25 printed below the totals (Activities Fund 70,000 and School Nutrition Fund 74,666.25 from General Fund); not in receipts/disbursements. Roll-forward: 2,711,281.59 + 21,287,403.10 - 6,436,402.89 = 17,562,281.80. Receipts lines are broad groups (Local, County, State, Federal) because the combined total-fund breakdown is printed only for the General Fund (Schedule A, p11-12), which is recorded in detail. Detail: General Fund receipts from Schedule A; General Fund disbursements from Schedule M (object-level, the more detailed schedule); Schedule B (program-level, p13-14) and Schedule A-1 (p10) not recorded to avoid double counting; Schedule N (p24, county treasurers pass-through) not recorded as duplicate of GF receipts. Schedule M printed Total Disbursements 5,054,392.00 includes transfers 144,666.25 (recorded as signed other financing lines). Schedule M lines with 0.00 or blank actual (e.g. 2630 salaries, 6990, 6997, 6998 and budget-only lines) omitted. Object mapping: Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance; Other Property Services -> professional/contract services; Property -> equipment purchases; Other Items -> dues, training and travel; Retirement/Increased Retirement/Employee Benefits -> employee benefits and payroll taxes. State/federal categorical programs (35xx, 6xxx) assigned to function instruction. Special Building, Bond, Employee Benefit, Activities and School Nutrition funds appear only in the basic statement columns (no detail schedules except Depreciation Fund). Statement of net position (Exhibit I) has only cash assets, no liabilities. Read pages 1-24 of 24
